function.name: calculate_investment_value
function.description: Calculate the future value of an investment given the principal, interest rate and term. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

principal.description: The initial amount of the investment. This is a float type value.

interest_rate.description: The annual interest rate in percentage. Enter as a decimal (for 5%, enter 0.05). This is a float type value.

term.description: The term of the investment in years.

compounding.description: The number of times that interest is compounded per year. Default is 1 (annually).

message.content:
Here’s a mix of classic, modern, and cult‑favorite horror films that should keep you on the edge of your seat:

| # | Title | Year | Why It’s Worth Watching |
|---|-------|------|------------------------|
| 1 | **The Shining** | 1980 | A masterclass in psychological dread, with iconic imagery and a chilling performance by Jack Nicholson. |
| 2 | **Hereditary** | 2018 | A brutal, slow‑burn horror that turns family drama into a nightmare, with Toni Collette’s Oscar‑nominated turn. |
| 3 | **Get Out** | 2017 | A smart, socially conscious thriller that blends horror with sharp satire. |
| 4 | **Midsommar** | 2019 | A daylight horror that subverts expectations, featuring unsettling folk rituals and stunning cinematography. |
| 5 | **The Babadook** | 2014 | A psychological horror that explores grief and motherhood, with a truly terrifying monster. |
| 6 | **It Follows** | 2014 | A fresh take on the supernatural, with a relentless, creeping sense of dread. |
| 7 | **A Quiet Place** | 2018 | A tense, sound‑driven thriller that keeps you glued to the screen. |
| 8 | **The Witch** | 2015 | A period horror that builds dread through atmosphere and meticulous detail. |
| 9 | **The Conjuring** | 2013 | A modern classic of haunted‑house horror, with a solid blend of scares and storytelling. |
|10 | **Suspiria** (2018) | 2018 | A visually striking remake that mixes supernatural terror with a haunting score. |
|11 | **The Ring** | 2002 | A chilling remake of the Japanese original, famous for its iconic “phone call” scene. |
|12 | **Paranormal Activity** | 2007 | A low‑budget film that uses found‑footage style to deliver genuine chills. |
|13 | **The Cabin in the Woods** | 2012 | A meta‑horror that plays with genre tropes while delivering plenty of scares. |
|14 | **The Others** | 2001 | A gothic thriller with a twist ending that will keep you guessing. |
|15 | **The Exorcist** | 1973 | A timeless horror that still feels fresh, with unforgettable scenes. |

Feel free to pick based on your mood—whether you want psychological terror, supernatural scares, or something that blends horror with social commentary. Happy watching!
